newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr Telecom - Infostrada talks progressing.
newsitem.headline: Fr Telecom - Infostrada talks progressing.

text.p: France Telecom chairman Michel Bon said on Wednesday talks with Olivetti about participating in telecoms joint-venture Infostrada were advancing but he declined to give a likely agreement date.

"We have already been in talks with Infostrada shareholders for some time to reach an alliance with them allowing France Telecom, and eventually, its partners to take a stake in the capital of Infostrada," he said at a news conference.

"The talks have advanced appreciably during the past months but we have not finished yet. Bearing in mind the hazards, I'll say that we are progressing. But I would not risk a prediction for the date of an agreement," he said.
